# Shapes

`decorative/shapes` &middot; content-level &middot; category: decorative

## Purpose

A strip of colored squares, circles or bars in the brand colors, as a graphic accent.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Three squares in primary, accent and secondary.
- **circles**: Circles (squares in Outlook desktop). Sets `radius: 50%`.
- **bars**: Wide short bars. Sets `size: 48px`, `height: 6px`, `count: 3`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `count` | number | `3` |
| `size` | length | `"24px"` |
| `height` | length | `"24px"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.sm"` |
| `radius` | length | `"0"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Colored cells honored. Circles fall back to squares. | Fine. | Blocks keep their colors. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('decorative/shapes', {}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "decorative/shapes",
  "data": {}
}
```
